name: China

flag.description: A red field with one large yellow five-pointed star in the canton and four smaller yellow stars arranged in an arc to its right.
flag.symbolism: Red represents the communist revolution; the large star stands for the Communist Party and the four smaller stars for the social classes of the people united around it.

hook: China has one big yellow star plus four small ones in the top-left corner; Vietnam has a single big star in the centre.
trivia: Known as the Five-star Red Flag, it was designed by Zeng Liansong, an economist who entered a national design competition in 1949.
Each of the four small stars has one point aimed at the centre of the large star.
